### Christ's Victory
Author: Truth for Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-24-2017.html
Passage: Micah 2:13
Points:
- Jesus acts as the divine trailblazer who goes ahead of His people and removes every obstacle in their path.
- The greatest threats—sin, death, and hell—have already been defeated and disarmed through Christ.
- While believers will still encounter spiritual opposition, they do battle against an already vanquished enemy.
- Christians can proceed with boldness and joy, assured of final victory and their heavenly reward.
